definitions.explanation: Oil used to reduce friction between moving parts in machinery and equipment.

definitions.gloss: something that smooths relations; social lubricant
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, something that helps relationships or interactions proceed smoothly.

examples.japanese: {機械|きかい}に{潤滑油|じゅんかつゆ}を{差|さ}す。
examples.english: Apply lubricating oil to the machine.

examples.japanese: {潤滑油|じゅんかつゆ}が{切|き}れると{故障|こしょう}の{原因|げんいん}になる。
examples.english: Running out of lubricant can cause breakdowns.

examples.japanese: {酒|さけ}はコミュニケーションの{潤滑油|じゅんかつゆ}だ。
examples.english: Alcohol is a social lubricant for communication.

notes:
WORD STRUCTURE:
{潤滑|じゅんかつ} (lubrication, smooth) + {油|ゆ} (oil)

LITERAL USAGE (Sense 1):
Used for machinery maintenance including:
・{自動車|じどうしゃ} - automobiles (engine oil)
・{工場|こうじょう}{機械|きかい} - factory machinery
・{自転車|じてんしゃ} - bicycles

FIGURATIVE USAGE (Sense 2):
Commonly used metaphorically to describe things that facilitate smooth interactions:
・お{酒|さけ} - alcohol
・ユーモア - humor
・{雑談|ざつだん} - small talk

RELATED TERMS:
・{潤滑|じゅんかつ} - lubrication
・{潤滑剤|じゅんかつざい} - lubricant (includes non-oil lubricants)
・グリス - grease
・オイル - oil
・{油|あぶら}を{差|さ}す - to oil, to lubricate

COLLOCATIONS:
・{潤滑油|じゅんかつゆ}を{差|さ}す/{塗|ぬ}る - to apply lubricant
・{潤滑油|じゅんかつゆ}が{切|き}れる - to run out of lubricant
・{潤滑油|じゅんかつゆ}の{役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たす - to serve as a lubricant (figurative)
